title: nelumbo nucifera subsp. lutea
intro: Nelumbo nucifera subsp. lutea, commonly known as the yellow lotus or golden lotus, is a subspecies of the Asian lotus plant that is native to East Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and lowering cholesterol levels, due to its ability to act as an antioxidant and anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Nelumbo nucifera subsp. lutea are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiovascular protective effects. Furthermore, the plant's rhizome and seeds are traditionally used in traditional medicine to treat various conditions, and its extracts have been studied for their potential to prevent cancer, improve cognitive function, and protect against neurodegenerative diseases.
